Problem summary

An iOS application may receive duplicate notifications for the same event. Given a list of notification IDs, count how many notifications are duplicates. An ID is considered a duplicate if it has appeared previously in the list.


Input format

A single line containing an integer N, followed by N integers representing notification IDs.


Output format

Print the total number of duplicate notifications.


Constraints

  • 1≤N≤1051 \le N \le 10^5
  • 1≤N≤105
  • 1≤ID≤1091 \le ID \le 10^9
  • 1≤ID≤109
